disassemblyPrompt:
Precise-object-edit, production sprite disassembly of the approved helicopter in INPUT1. Do not redesign its silhouette, canopy, tail, armor, olive-gray colors, mechanical detailing or pixel texture. INPUT2 is ONLY a technical reference showing how the existing game depicts left/right banking as side surfaces become visible. Do not copy INPUT2's aircraft design. Prepare a TRANSPARENT sprite parts sheet with exactly TEN isolated cells, FIVE equal columns by TWO equal rows, no labels or grid lines. Keep generous clear gutters, identical body scale, identical north-facing heading in every cell. Top row left to right: body neutral (roll0), body roll minus8, body roll minus16, body roll minus24, body roll plus8. Bottom row left to right: body roll plus16, body roll plus24, isolated machinegun, isolated missile launcher, isolated FOUR-BLADE X main rotor.
Body cells show the EXACT APPROVED INPUT1 fuselage/cockpit/tail/shoulder armor WITHOUT ANY ROTOR BLADES and WITHOUT either weapon. Retain the stationary rotor bearing and short weapon mounting brackets as attachment points on the body. Restore only the small hidden body areas previously covered by blades or guns, matching the existing panels. NO baked ground shadow. All seven bodies must be the same aircraft: preserve canopy, armor pattern, tailplane and marking placement. Banking is ROLL ABOUT THE LENGTHWISE NOSE-TAIL AXIS, not yaw and not nose-up/nose-down pitching. Keep nose at top and tail at bottom; at negative roll show more of the aircraft's left side armor thickness and hide a little right top surface, increasing progressively 8,16,24 degrees. Positive roll shows corresponding right-side thickness. Do not merely squash/tilt a flat sheet; draw the newly visible side surfaces and occlusion correctly. The neutral first cell is the approved body with only blades/weapons removed, NOT a new design.
Bottom cell3: isolate the approved LEFT slender machinegun and mounting housing, barrel still pointing NORTH. Bottom cell4: isolate the approved RIGHT lengthwise missile launcher pointing NORTH, no front-facing circles. Restore only tiny occluded portions using visible geometry. Bottom cell5: isolate the EXACT FOUR-BLADE X rotor from input1 with its hub, completely independent and clean, all four full blades. Weapons and rotor at the SAME SCALE AS ALL BODY CELLS so reassembly recreates input1. No extra blades, no new weapon type, no extra wings, no text, no ground scenery, no extra aircraft. Retain delicate irregular pixel clusters and original desaturated weathered metal; do not replace with cartoon black outline, glossy3D or smoothed painting. These are separable components for the already approved design.
correction: Remove duplicated weapon barrels from seven body cells; preserve mounting pads and separate gun/missile/rotor.
productionSteps: Crop each component from transparent source with alpha16 bounds plus 2px edge margin.
Remove disconnected generation residue from production masks; preserve adopted and generated originals.
Uniform scale each component once to adopted proportional size, rotate clockwise90, align bearing and sockets.
Pack seven existing drawn bank poses without procedural silhouette warp.
Encode CgBI using Apple pngcrush -iphone -f 0; verify exact alpha and opaque RGB.
